obstacle_memory.recording: ToF Zone::Hit only, transformed by current x/y/yaw into odometry-frame cells; floor excluded, cells age out and are cleared on detected odometry jump. No free-space clearing.
obstacle_memory.forward: Minimum of live forward ToF reduction and remembered cells in forward corridor.
obstacle_memory.backward: Remembered head-ToF cells behind current pose only; no rear sensor added.
obstacle_memory.fall_handling: Same-direction walk immediately before a scheduled fall uses wall+fall_room. Guarded/blocked fall attempts turn and up-to1s walk-in; unresolved room logs fall_skipped and unanchors schedule. Six scheduled slots do not imply six actual falls.
obstacle_memory.turn_bound: TAU/max(abs(commanded vyaw),0.1)+0.5 seconds; boxed_in then standing for remaining walk slot. No measured full-turn proof.
obstacle_memory.home_reanchor: Wall encountered on square-return path may move home to current pose and emit home_moved; approximate map/odometry do not prove physical drift.
obstacle_memory.loss_behavior: No new stop-on-depth-loss requirement. Previously remembered cells remain age-limited; no live/memorized obstacle can be treated as clear by the driver. Not a navigation or physical safety acceptance.

offline_concatenation.time_axis: When t_s fields are present/non-null, samples/events independently split at timer drops greater than1s, ordinal piece ends laid end-to-end. offline_concatenation.comparison_checks: Mixed known lap versions refused; different fall mode in last metadata segments only warns. No equality check of trip_ms/trip_legs or source revision; lap stress-v1 alone does not ensure comparable conditions.
offline_concatenation.drain: session column prevents sample pairs across concatenated sessions; not integration/acceptance of separate unmerged PR504.
offline_concatenation.compatibility_limits: Static read: nonempty events.csv lacking t_s is indexed before fallback; independent sample/event reset detection is not identity-aligned. look_back_contract.when: Before every walk with vx<0, before scheduling its full step duration; missing initial pose returns without a look.
look_back_contract.sequence: Request RobotLook(0,1,0,neck_pitch0), turn body towards initial_yaw+PI/2, hold0.4s, sample left-corridor nearest Hit for0.3s and keep minimum. Request RobotLook(1,0,0,neck_pitch0). If nearer than required range, turn toward initial_yaw+PI then reverse away; otherwise return towards initial yaw and reverse. Emit look_back, unanchor schedule.
look_back_contract.geometry: nearest_left maps point[x,y,z] to[y,-x,z] and applies existing0.15m half-width corridor/Hit filter. Body/head quarter turns are intended geometry, not measured HD1910 head arrival or rear coverage.
look_back_contract.turning: Each turn_to uses wrapped odometry yaw error tolerance0.08rad and nominal4s loop deadline. Missing pose or deadline returns Ok; connection/retry work may exceed deadline. No failure result proves heading reached.
look_back_contract.depth: Existing depth-cache age limit500ms; sample window has no explicit post-turn fresh-frame identity barrier. Missing valid depth/Hit can become clear:nothing rather than stop.
look_back_contract.head_ownership: RobotLook accepted/result not checked; fixed0.4s hold is not an arrival acknowledgement. End requests forward gaze, not restoration of previous target; concurrent head-control/ToF calibration still need own review.
look_back_contract.live_guard: Forward walk and square return use live ahead guard; reverse walk does not continuously check rear depth. Wall guard clears at >=wall*1.5 or no obstacle, without prior boxed_in cap.
look_back_contract.time_and_measurement: Look is outside the backward step slot and adds turns/head work/time/current. Planned slots and real fall counts must be reconstructed from events and source; no new physical endurance measurement.
look_back_contract.new_test_definition: nearest_left_looks_along_the_left; static source read only, not full look-back sequence/hardware acceptance.

history.classification: pending recovery-policy change with separate dev build; not main/formal or own updater
history.priority: high contract review before upstream updater adoption; no automatic default change in project

review.setting: [update_gate] auto_rollback defaults false; configure exposes it. Updater Config::robotd_config defaults /etc/robot/robotd.toml; read on each decision without updaterd restart. Boot script reads at boot.
review.engine_scope: Both post-swap error arms after apply/select/explicit rollback consult the flag. In apply, post_swap includes post-install hook, service apply action, updater self-test and health gate, so off changes more than health-only failures.
review.off_result: Failed target remains live and returns Stuck with a manual rollback command. keep_failed confirms/clears the trial; Stuck is journalled Aborted rather than RolledBack, hence not added to known_bad and can be selected later. It does not mean healthy or that recovery happened.
review.boot_counter: Exhausted unconfirmed trial with off is recorded once as Stuck and cleared; no automatic previous/golden fallback through that branch.
review.boot_check: After a failed unit verdict, non-dry-run with off logs failed units/manual robot-rescue --reboot and exits2 without handing over. --dry-run still exits3 for the same failure, before consulting the flag, for the OS slot gate. This is not a universal switch for all OS-level recovery.
review.parsing_limit: Rust uses layered_text/TOML merge, user layer winning; syntactically invalid user layer is discarded, so base=true may remain true. Effective missing/non-bool/read or parse failure yields false. Shell uses per-line awk and literal true, not the same parser; invalid-user-layer cases can therefore disagree and require review. Do not claim any malformed user config always disables rollback.
review.preserved: Manual rollback and existing recovery implementation remain. Signature/hash/compatibility checks and pre-swap rejection are not disabled; hardware safety policy is not changed.
review.verification_limit: Seven new definitions read only. Existing rollback fixtures explicitly enable the flag. Author says Docker-dependent board-test.sh/systemd-test.sh were not run locally and CI runs them; this is not evidence that CI or project tests passed.

latest_followup.change: Real-robotd gate fixture writes auto_rollback=true and supplies robotd_config; restores boot-counter reverting log text required by board-test.sh only on the actual revert path. No new test definitions, new default-policy change, or proven CI pass.

history.title: laser: scan only around the dot while tracking
history.classification: Open PR against main. No matching development package in the checked release list.

review.search: When a last dot is available and a full scan is not due, the first pass looks for candidates within four configured radii each way around it. At radius 24 this is about 192 by 192 pixels before edge clipping. The second pass measures the candidate in its own neighborhood. A local result counts if within two radii of the last dot. A miss or farther candidate triggers full-frame fallback during the same look.
review.rescan_and_peak: Once a second is due, the next available look scans the full frame. A higher-scoring point elsewhere may wait until that look. A local look reports the redder of its own peak and the cached full-frame peak.
review.performance: Author reports 19.5 microseconds window vs 474 microseconds full-frame scanning on a Mac at 1280×720. The quoted face-board-v1 CPU numbers predate this change. Current whole-frame copy and sampling cadence remain in the source. No board measurement for this revision.

type5_reader.supported_path: ST25R100 over SPI only; serial CLRC663/USB branch remains Type2/ISO14443A.
type5_reader.polling: On each of two antennas ask A then V, first detected tag wins. V inventory is single-slot and assumes one tag; not general multi-tag discovery. Switch toV then reset RF field before inventory; next A restores A settings.
type5_reader.protocol_registers: begin retains prior A setup and snapshots7registers; V alone applies AM regulator/12percent modulation/receiver settings; A restores snapshot and AM bit. Register-file test definitions are static only, not RF regression acceptance.
type5_reader.flags: Final source names0x04Inventory and0x20one-slot in inventory mode, so inventory request0x26;0x06is16-slot. Replaces old bring-up explanation, not an ST-specific extra flag.
type5_reader.read_bounds: Read addressed blocks by UID. CC MLEN bounds memory, capped at32blocks;4byte CC for nonzero MLEN,8byte CC for zero MLEN and RFU bytes4-5clear, legacy MLEN0/nonclear TLV keeps4byte fallback. Not an unlimited large-memory/extended-address reader.
type5_reader.tlv_handling: If first TLV sizes NDEF, read its needed bytes; otherwise read declared/capped area so leading Lock Control TLV can be skipped by shared parser. No CC returns blank; NDEF needing bytes beyond bounded end reports error instead of intentional truncation.
type5_reader.ndef_format: Type2 NTAG or SPI Type5 ST25TV/ICODE needs readable NDEF with existing exact pairing token; format/phone/reader suitability still device-specific.
type5_reader.timing_trace: Default5Hz retained; source comments estimate empty beta poll~110ms and recommend<=5Hz, not measured own timing. SPI tracing uses RUST_LOG=nfc::spi=trace and logs only first12TX/RX bytes, not full capture. Bench example added but not executed.

review.setting: [update_gate] auto_rollback defaults false; configure exposes it. Updater Config::robotd_config defaults /etc/robot/robotd.toml; read on each decision without updaterd restart. Boot script reads at boot.
review.engine_scope: Both post-swap error arms after apply/select/explicit rollback consult the flag. In apply, post_swap includes post-install hook, service apply action, updater self-test and health gate, so off changes more than health-only failures.
review.off_result: Failed target remains live and returns Stuck with a manual rollback command. keep_failed confirms/clears the trial; Stuck is journalled Aborted rather than RolledBack, hence not added to known_bad and can be selected later. It does not mean healthy or that recovery happened.
review.boot_counter: Exhausted unconfirmed trial with off is recorded once as Stuck and cleared; no automatic previous/golden fallback through that branch.
review.boot_check: After a failed unit verdict, non-dry-run with off logs failed units/manual robot-rescue --reboot and exits2 without handing over. --dry-run still exits3 for the same failure, before consulting the flag, for the OS slot gate. This is not a universal switch for all OS-level recovery.
review.parsing_limit: Rust uses layered_text/TOML merge, user layer winning; syntactically invalid user layer is discarded, so base=true may remain true. Effective missing/non-bool/read or parse failure yields false. Shell uses per-line awk and literal true, not the same parser; invalid-user-layer cases can therefore disagree and require review. Do not claim any malformed user config always disables rollback.
review.preserved: Manual rollback and existing recovery implementation remain. Signature/hash/compatibility checks and pre-swap rejection are not disabled; hardware safety policy is not changed.
review.verification_limit: Seven new definitions read only. Existing rollback fixtures explicitly enable the flag. Author says Docker-dependent board-test.sh/systemd-test.sh were not run locally and CI runs them; this is not evidence that CI or project tests passed.

review.change: Open #563 targets the secure media/BLE draft #556. It adds EEPROM-backed setup codes and automatic credential import. Daemon IPC stays at the parent branch API51.
review.layout: Beta and FaceBoardV1 ID EEPROM on I2C1 at 0x50. Bytes 0–17 remain the label serial; byte 18 is a colon; the md1 code starts at 19 and ends at NUL or 0xFF. The production QR includes the label serial prefix. ASCII format with no checksum.
review.key_precedence: Root export prefers an EEPROM code whose id matches the SoC-derived first name. With an absent or empty code area it may read the developer file. A malformed, unreadable or wrong-id EEPROM is an error and blocks that fallback. install refuses both a populated and an unreadable EEPROM.
review.boot_and_recovery: configd ExecStartPre runs export with failures ignored for configd startup. Export writes the root-only key under /run/credstore or removes a stale key on a no-code or invalid-code outcome when removal succeeds. On the default unit path, btd uses the PIN when no key is imported. A valid label serial continues to supply the existing label PIN.
review.gateway: btd and duck-gateway are ordered after configd and import the credential. Explicit key-file overrides remain. With the imported key the gateway can listen on 9443 and forward authenticated sessions to loopback 8443. Without a key it exits without listening. The gateway adds an Install section for daemon postinstall enablement. Yocto integration remains separate.
review.validation_boundary: Author reports tests and clippy for the five named crates, explicitly no board run. Source definitions cover decoding, wrong id and QR layout. Fixed-head CI coverage, board job and publish are successful. The general check job was still in progress at the captured observation. behavior.positive_failure: failed ActiveState or NRestarts >= 3, regardless of present state; hand over immediately.
behavior.early_pass: All present members active continuously for at least 10 seconds.
behavior.config_read: Line-level read of base then user robotd.toml; user numeric value wins, unreadable/nondecimal key ignored.
behavior.at_deadline: No failed/3-restart member means exit 0 even with inactive/unsettled members; not full functional acceptance.
behavior.old_guards: Absent units skipped; uptime >600 seconds declines; rescue safeguards retained.
behavior.dry_run: Now returns 3 where rescue would be requested; does not invoke rescue.
behavior.configure: NextBoot effect; does not offer robotd restart for this key.

limits: Approximately 25 seconds is an expected healthy Yocto beta verdict from author measurements, not replica boot time or gait/sensor acceptance.
Active includes a daemon waiting for hardware; padd, camera and ToF are not members of this check.
A too-short deadline can miss updaterd crash loops whose restart threshold takes about45 seconds; clamp permits20 seconds, so it is not a guarantee.
Postinstall copies the script and units; script copy failure only warns and retains the previous copy. Verify actual installed files and next boot.
OS slot marking/page latency also depends on separate microduck_yocto PR75 and a built OS image; PR75 merged during review at a7d1468; no containing OS build or board acceptance verified.
